The '''Carbon-Ice Drive''', also referred to as the '''comet computer''' was an advanced [[Starship/Legends|starship]] technology developed by the [[Adarian/Legends|Adarians]]. It was used in a starship's computer systems, and it was made from supercooled, [[Carbon/Legends|carbon]]-laced [[Water/Legends|ice]] taken from [[Comet/Legends|comets]]. The units could be up to 200 [[Meter/Legends|meters]] in size which was counter to the trend of miniaturization with starship systems. However, the system was extremely powerful and capable of housing [[Artificial intelligence/Legends|artificial intelligences]].
